children.name: FAQ Headline
children.characters: What Providers should know before work begins.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: How is project scope defined and agreed upon?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Scope is documented in detail during the PROPOSE and ALIGN phases. Both parties must digitally sign off on the final Statement of Work before the project moves to SECURE.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What happens if the client requests changes after agreement?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Scope changes require a formal Change Order, which is negotiated and agreed upon. This may adjust timeline and pricing, and must be approved before work on new scope begins.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: How does the escrow system protect my earnings?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Funds are deposited by the client into a secure escrow account during the SECURE phase. They are released upon milestone completion and client approval.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Can I set milestone-based payments instead of lump sum?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Yes. Complex projects often utilize milestone-based delivery, where specific deliverables trigger partial payment releases from escrow.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What is the standard timeline for client review?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Clients typically have 5 business days to review submitted work. If no action is taken, the milestone may auto-approve depending on contract terms.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: How are disputes handled if the client rejects the work?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: If a revision request cannot be resolved, Mondial Flex offers a structured mediation process to ensure fair assessment against the original agreed scope.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Are platform fees deducted before or after escrow release?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Platform fees are automatically deducted at the time of funds release from escrow, before the final payout reaches your account.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Can I use external tools for project management?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: While delivery can happen anywhere, all formal communication, milestone submissions, and approvals must occur on-platform for protection.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What happens if a project is cancelled mid-delivery?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Cancellation policies are defined in the agreement. Typically, providers are compensated for milestones completed and approved up to the cancellation date.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: How does completion impact my Mondial Score?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Successfully completed projects, adherence to timelines, and positive client reviews directly contribute to improving your Tier Status and visibility.
